summary.zh: 吉祥物乘交通工具一镜到底横穿一座扁平插画城市，每个街区是一个内容类别：顶部一张车票标着路线和站名，每站甩来一张明信片写这一类的代表内容，天色从白天走到夜晚，到终点这张车票滑到画面中间、检票打孔、翻面露出产品名。适合内容多、类别清楚的产品（内容平台、多功能软件、多门店多品类、课程体系）
summary.en: A mascot rides through a flat-illustrated city in one continuous take; each district is a content category: a ticket at the top tracks the route and the stop name, a postcard for each stop carries a sample title, the sky moves from day to night, and at the terminus that same ticket slides to the centre, gets punched and flips over to show the product name. Fits products with many clearly separated categories
